SELECT f.*, u.nickname, d.dept_name FROM sys_file f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=f.create_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.dept_id=f.dept_id
f.file_server_url LIKE CONCAT('%',#{fileServerUrl},'%')
AND f.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{fileName},'%')
AND f.file_server_url LIKE '%/images/%' AND f.file_server_url LIKE '%/videos/%' AND f.file_server_url NOT LIKE '%/images/%' AND f.file_server_url NOT LIKE '%/videos/%'
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{nickname},'%')
AND f.create_time >= #{startTime} AND f.create_time <= #{endTime}
AND f.dept_id=#{deptId}
ORDER BY update_time DESC
